hero.title: Find out if you fit
hero.subtitle: Paste the job description and eptus gives you an honest match against your CV: what is missing, what is extra and why.

steps.heading: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three steps. The first one is on eptus.

one.title: Upload your CV
one.body: Do it once. eptus reads it, structures it and builds the profile it will compare with.

two.title: Paste the job
two.body: Copy the full job description. That is enough: no forms, no steps.

three.title: See the match
three.body: A score, your strengths, what is missing and the reasoning. No hype, nothing invented.

features.heading: What you get
features.subtitle: eptus does not tell you that you are the best. It tells you where you fit.

match.title: An honest match
match.body: The score comes with the reasons: strengths, gaps and the reasoning behind each one.

adapt.title: A tailored CV, nothing invented
adapt.body: We rewrite your experience so it fits the role. A honesty check blocks anything that is not in your CV.

audit.title: Anonymous audit
audit.body: Paste your CV and get a quality diagnosis instantly, without creating an account.

offers.title: Job alerts
offers.body: Tell us what you are looking for and we let you know when something matches your profile.

pricing.heading: Plans
pricing.subtitle: Prices in Colombian pesos. Pay with Wompi or Mercado Pago, no middlemen.
pricing.freeNote: To try the match without a card.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: It stays in your account and is only used to compare against the jobs you analyze. You can delete it whenever you want.
faq.q2: Does the score mean I will be hired?
faq.a2: No. It is an honest read of how well your profile fits the role, with the reasons in plain sight. The decision is yours.
faq.q3: Can I cancel whenever I want?
faq.a3: Yes. Cancel from your plan page and keep the free plan: your history and your CV stay.
faq.q4: Do I need a card to try it?
faq.a4: No. The free plan asks for no card and covers 3 analyses a month.

final.title: Ready?
final.body: Create your account, upload your CV and paste your first job. Three analyses are on us.
